[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Edvar Vang''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] who lived on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|It's ... what the? I haven't seen anything like this since... do you realize what this represents?''"<br />"''Is this illegal? Is it dangerous?''"<br />"''It's dangerous to me!|Doctor Vang, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MD" />}}
Edvar Vang resided in the city of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] and practiced in the local medical center. He was a cousin of [[Tyla Jinn]], a woman living on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], but both were not on good terms. During his career, Doctor Vang had worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as well as for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He had ties with both Imperial and Rebel officers [[Jevan Monsul]] and [[Veega Madish]]<ref name="SWG:MD" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Doctor Vang and a friend by the name of [[Moxxar Krieg]] discovered the existence of a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]].<ref name="SWG:MD" /> This spice was trafficked by the Rebel Alliance but was also sought by the powerful criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref> After they were detected and threatened, Vang considered that the situation had become too dangerous while Krieg decided to continue to investigate the source of this spice. The latter was finally assassinated in his [[Moxxar Krieg's house|house]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:MD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of spacers discovered a sample of the new spice while looking for a missing pilot, [[Cal Handro]]. They brought it to Doctor Vang but the latter exhorted them to interrogate Krieg instead of him, ignoring that his fried was already dead. The spacers traveled to Tatooine but only found the corpse of Moxxar Krieg in his house in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:MD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateScientistHumanMale.png|thumb|right|250px|Every randomly-generated depiction of Edvar Vang.]]
Edvar Vang was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Edvar Vang was added to the game with the first chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" questline, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 14 Notes for 9 March 05|Publish 14]]," on [[March 9]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=730|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

Edvar Vang's appearance would fluctuate after each server reset, but he consistently appeared as a Human male under the template "scientist_human_male".<ref name="SWG:MD" />
